Generated by `cargo run --bin export_vk -- toy --output testdata/toy_vk.bin`
from the cosmwasm workspace.

| File | Circuit | curve_id | k | i | Size |
|------|---------|----------|---|---|------|
| `toy_vk.bin` | Toy (Pasta, generic Plonkish) | 0 | 4 | 1 | 1531 bytes |
| `square_vk.bin` | BN254 Groth16 multiplier (a·b=c) Phase A blob | 4 | 0 | 1 | ~376 B |
| `square_proof.bin` | ark-compressed Groth16 proof (a=3,b=5,c=15) | — | — | — | ~128 B |

### Regenerating BN254 golden fixtures

Deterministic ark-groth16 setup+prove (seed 42, MultCircuit a=3,b=5):

```bash
cd .
ZK_WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p zk-cosmwasm --features bn254 --lib write_or_load_committed_golden
```

## How to regenerate

```bash
cd .
cargo run --bin export_vk -- toy --output packages/zk/testdata/toy_vk.bin
```

## How to generate real circuit VK files

The delegation, vote_proof, and share_reveal circuits use `halo2_proofs = "0.3"` (crates.io)
which does not expose `VerifyingKey::write()` or `VerifyingKey::cs()` publicly.

**Fix: Add `pub fn write()` and `pub fn cs()` to the vote-sdk's halo2 0.3 fork.**

In the vote-sdk's `halo2_proofs` dependency (either a local fork or a `[patch]` section),
add these two methods to `VerifyingKey` in `src/plonk.rs`:

```rust
// Add to impl<C: CurveAffine> VerifyingKey<C> block:
pub fn cs(&self) -> &ConstraintSystem<C::Scalar> {
    &self.cs
}

// The write() implementation is already in the local fork at zcash/halo2/halo2_proofs.
// Copy it from there, or path-depend the local fork:
//   halo2_proofs = { git = "https://github.com/permissionlessweb/halo2", rev = "362ca361477bea76e30507b6f731a3abd5e85303" }
```

Once the VK has `write()` and `cs()`:

```bash
cd the monorepo/crates/vote-sdk/circuits
cargo run --bin gen_vk_data -- delegation   --output-dir /tmp/vk_data/
cargo run --bin gen_vk_data -- vote_proof   --output-dir /tmp/vk_data/
cargo run --bin gen_vk_data -- share_reveal --output-dir /tmp/vk_data/

# Then wrap with footer:
cd .
cargo run --bin export_vk -- delegation \
  --params /tmp/vk_data/delegation_params.bin \
  --vk-body /tmp/vk_data/delegation_vk_body.bin \
  --output packages/zk/testdata/delegation_vk.bin
```

## Prover ID (`CircuitType`) reference

| prover_id | Name | Notes |
|-----------|------|-------|
| 0 | Plonkish | Halo2 IPA; reusable params, `k` in footer |
| 1 | Groth16 | No Halo2-style params; see empty-param footer below |

## Empty-param footer convention (BN254 / Groth16)

Groth16 circuits do **not** share Halo2 reusable IPA params. Phase A stores them with:

```text
prover_id      = 1 (Groth16)
curve_id       = 4 (Bn254)
k              = 0 (unused)
i              = public input field-element count
param_len      = 0
cs_len         = 0
vk_len         = |vk_bytes|
param_checksum = SHA256([])     # empty byte string — fixed sentinel
vk_checksum    = SHA256(vk_bytes)
```

Blob layout is still `[params | cs+vk | footer]` with a zero-length `params`
prefix. Split storage writes an empty `zk_param/{param_key}.bin` (or the loader
tolerates a missing param file when `param_len=0`). Do **not** invent a fake
4-byte Halo2 `k` header for BN254.

`Bn254VerifyingKey::verify` remains a stub until Phase B (ark-groth16).
